summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py (TaskProgressColumn show_speed option and render_speed staticmethod, track() show_speed option defaulting to True, Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables with no total), added a CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added entry, removed the two ValueError assertions in tests/test_progress.py, and added test_task_progress_column_speed. Nothing was run (no tests, mypy, or black) per instructions, and nothing was committed. Expected behavior for the unsized-iterable-without-total case is now a TypeError raised during iteration of the non-iterable value, which the existing tests exercise without an assertion.
